title: Effectiveness of Anti-littering Enforcement Actions and Possibility of Scaling Up
what_it_is: Effectiveness of Anti-littering Enforcement Actions and Possibility of Scaling Up

sections.label: NEA high-rise littering enforcement
sections.summary: NEA increased surveillance camera deployments by over 50% in 2020 and worked with Town Councils, enabling over 1,000 enforcement actions against high-rise litterbugs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In 2020, NEA has stepped up enforcement against high-rise littering by increasing the number of surveillance camera deployments by over 50% as compared to 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA also partnered closely with Town Councils to enable more timely information-sharing to facilitate the investigation of high-rise littering offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: These measures enabled NEA to take more than 1,000 enforcement actions against high-rise litterbugs in 2020.

sections.label: Technology and Town Council cooperation
sections.summary: NEA used technology and data analytics, increased camera deployments by over 50% since 2020, and worked more closely with Town Councils on information sharing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, we leveraged technology and data analytics in order to apprehend high-rise litterbugs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And as I have noted, since last year, 2020, we have actually increased our camera deployments by more than 50%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have also worked more closely with the Town Councils to enable more timely sharing of information in order to facilitate our investigations.

sections.label: High-rise littering penalties and cameras
sections.summary: NEA will use better camera technology; first high-rise littering offence carries up to $2,000 fine and/or CWO, third and subsequent up to $10,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition to that, of course, we will continue to look at using better camera technology in terms of better image resolution as well as detection capabilities and so on to be more effective.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, for high-rise littering, the first offence is already a Court conviction, with a maximum of $2,000 fine and/or CWO.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The third and subsequent offences are a maximum of $10,000 fine and/or CWO.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For instance, when we have a camera capture of a high-rise littering act, we are working with Town Councils to put up standees in that affected block to inform residents that high-rise littering offences have been committed and have been captured by camera deployments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, although the number of offences per offender may be higher for high-rise littering because the camera will capture multiple acts of high-rise littering, but, for repeat offenders, actually, the percentage is lower.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, it does show that what we are doing does have a deterrent effect if we are able to identify and apprehend them.
